en: The Vaṃśabrāhmaṇa: Homage to Brahman; homage to the Brāhmaṇas; homage to the teachers; homage to the seers; homage to the gods.

Salutation to Vāyu, to Mṛtyu, to Viṣṇu, and to Vaiśravaṇa. 1. Śārvadatta Gārgya received [this teaching] from Upajāyata Śārvadatta Gārgya. 2. Śārvadatta Gārgya [received it] from Rudrabhūti Drāhyāyaṇa. 3. Rudrabhūti Drāhyāyaṇa [received it] from Trāta Aiṣumata. 4. Trāta Aiṣumata [received it] from Nigaḍa Pārṇavalki. 5. Nigaḍa Pārṇavalki [received it] from Giriśarman Kāṇṭheviddhi. 6. Giriśarman Kāṇṭheviddhi [received it] from Brahmavṛddhi Chāndogamāhaki. 7. [The lineage continues: ...from Brahmavṛddhi Chāndogamāhaki.

Brahmavṛddhi from Chāndoga Māhaki Mitravarcas; Mitravarcas Sthairakāyana from Supratīta Aulundya; Supratīta Aulundya from Bṛhaspatigupta Śāyasthi; Bṛhaspatigupta Śāyasthi from Bhavatrāta Śāyasthi; Bhavatrāta Śāyasthi from Kustuka Śārkarākṣya; Kustuka Śārkarākṣya from Śravaṇadatta Kauhala; Śravaṇadatta Kauhala from Suśārada Śālaṅkāyana.

Suśārada Śālaṅkāyana from Ūrjayanta Aupamanyava; 15. Ūrjayanta Aupamanyava from Bhānumant Aupamanyava; 16. Bhānumant Aupamanyava from Ānandaja Cāndhanāyana; 17. Ānandaja Cāndhanāyana from Śāmba Śārkarākṣya and Kāmboja Aupamanyava; 18. Śāmba Śārkarākṣya and Kāmboja Aupamanyava from Madrakāra Śauṅgāyani; 19. Madrakāra Śauṅgāyani from Svāti Auṣṭrākṣi; 20. Svāti Auṣṭrākṣi from Suśravas.

From Vārṣagaṇya [21] Suśravas Vārṣagaṇya; from Prātarahna Kauhala [22] Prātarahna Kauhala; from Ketu Vādya [23] Ketu Vādya; from Mitravinda Kauhala [24] Mitravinda Kauhala; from Sunītha Kāpaṭava [25] Sunītha Kāpaṭava; from Sutemanas Śāṇḍilyāyana [26] Sutemanas Śāṇḍilyāyana; from Am̐śu Dhaumrāyaṇa [27] 1.

Aṃśu Dhāñjayya from Chāṇḍilyāyana and Rādha Gautama; 1. Rādha Gautama from Gātṛ Gautama, his father; 2. Gātṛ Gautama from Saṃvargajit Lāmakāyana; 3. Saṃvargajit Lāmakāyana from Śākadāsa Bhāḍitāyana; 4. Śākadāsa Bhāḍitāyana from Vicakṣaṇa Tāṇḍya; 5. Vicakṣaṇa Tāṇḍya from Gardabhīmukha Śāṇḍilyāyana; 6. Gardabhīmukha Śāṇḍilyāyana from Udara Śāṇḍilya, his father; 7. Udara Śāṇḍilya from Atidhanvan.

From Śaunaka and Maśaka from Gārgya; 8. Maśaka Gārgya from Sthiraka Gārgya, his father; 9. Sthiraka Gārgya from Vāsiṣṭha Caikitāneya; 10. Vāsiṣṭha Caikitāneya from Vāsiṣṭha Ārehaṇya Rājanya; 11. Vāsiṣṭha Ārehaṇya Rājanya from Sumantra Bābhrava Gautama; 12. Sumantra Bābhrava Gautama from Śūṣa Vāhneya Bhāradvāja; 13. Śūṣa Vāhneya Bhāradvāja from Arāla Dārteya Śaunaka; 14. Arāla Dārteya Śaunaka.

Dṛti Aindra from Tācchaunaka, who was his father; 15. Dṛti Aindra from Tācchaunaka, who was Indra, from his father alone; 16. Indra from Tācchaunaka, from Vṛṣaśuṣma Vātāvata; 17. Vṛṣaśuṣma Vātāvata from Nikothaka Bhāyajātya; 18. Nikothaka Bhāyajātya from Pratithi Devataratha; 19. Pratithi Devataratha from Devataras Śāvasāyana, who was his father; 20. Devataras Śāvasāyana from Śavas, who was his father alone; 21. Śavas from Agnibhu Kāśyapa; 22.

Agnibhū Kāśyapa [received it] from Indrabhū Kāśyapa; 23. Indrabhū Kāśyapa from Mitrabhū Kāśyapa; 24. Mitrabhū Kāśyapa from his father Vibhuṇḍaka Kāśyapa; 25. Vibhaṇḍaka Kāśyapa from his father Ṛṣyaśṛṅga Kāśyapa; 26. Ṛṣyaśṛṅga Kāśyapa from his own father Kaśyapa; 27. Kaśyapa from Agni; 28. Agni from Indra; 29. Indra from Vāyu; 30. Vāyu from Mṛtyu; 31. Mṛtyu from Prajāpati; 32.
Prajāpati from Brahmā; 33. Brahmā is self-existent (svayambhū). 34. Salutation to him, salutation to him! 35. 2.
Having paid homage to the teachers, one should then proclaim one's lineage;
thus there is *svadhā* for the ancestors, and one attains a long life as a leader.

Having said this, one should recite the lineage back to Brahmā: 1. Aryamabhūti from Kālabava; 2. Aryamabhūti Kālabava from Bhadraśarman Kauśika; 3. Bhadraśarman Kauśika from Puṣpayaśas Audavraji; 4. Puṣpayaśas Audavraji from Saṃkara Gautama; 5. Saṃkara Gautama from Aryamarādha Gobhila and Pūṣāmitra Gobhila; 6. Pūṣāmitra Gobhila from Aśvāmitra Gobhila; 7. Aśvāmitra Gobhila from Varuṇamitra Gobhila; 8. [Varuṇamitra Gobhila from...].

Varuṇamitra from Gobhila; [this] Gobhila from Mūlamitra; 9. Mūlamitra from Gobhila; [this] Gobhila from Vatsamitra; 10. Vatsamitra from Gobhila; [this] Gobhila from the son of Gaulgulavī; 11. The son of Gaulgulavī from Gobhila; [this] Gobhila from his father Bṛhadvasu; 12. Bṛhadvasu from Gobhila; [this] Gobhila from Gobhila himself; 13. Gobhila from Rādhagautama; 14. The further [lineage] is the same; the further [lineage] is the same; 15. 3.
